query:
SELECT leagueNameJp, round, homeTeam, awayTeam, 
       FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoffUtcMs/1000, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i UTC') as kickoff_utc,
       FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoffUtcMs/1000 + 9*3600, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i JST') as kickoff_jst,
       status
FROM matches
WHERE leagueId IN (4480, 5071)
ORDER BY kickoffUtcMs DESC
LIMIT 20;
